AVCaptureView.doc: A view that displays standard user interface controls for capturing media data.

AVPictureInPictureController.doc: A controller that responds to user-initiated Picture in Picture playback of video in a floating, resizable window.

AVPictureInPictureControllerContentSourc.doc: An object that represents the source of the content to present in Picture in Picture.

AVPlaybackSpeed.doc: An object that represents a user-selectable playback speed in a playback user interface.

AVPlayerView.doc: A view that displays content from a player and presents a native user interface to control playback.

AVRoutePickerView.doc: A view that presents a list of nearby media receivers.

AVCaptureViewDelegate.doc: The protocol that defines the methods you can implement to respond to capture view events.

AVPictureInPictureControllerDelegate.doc: A protocol to adopt to respond to Picture in Picture events.

AVPictureInPictureSampleBufferPlaybackDe.doc: A protocol for controlling playback from a sample buffer display layer in Picture in Picture.

AVPlayerViewDelegate.doc: A protocol that defines the methods to implement to participate in the player view’s full-screen presentation life cycle.

AVPlayerViewPictureInPictureDelegate.doc: A protocol that defines the methods to implement to respond to Picture in Picture playback events.

AVRoutePickerViewDelegate.doc: A protocol that defines the methods to adopt to respond to route picker view presentation events.

AVCaptureViewControlsStyle.doc: Constants that describe the capture view’s supported controls styles.

AVCaptureViewControlsStyleFloating.doc: The view’s floating controls style, which matches the user interface of QuickTime Player.

AVCaptureViewControlsStyleInlineDeviceSe.doc: The view’s inline device selection style.

AVDisplayDynamicRange.doc: Describes how High Dynamic Range (HDR) video content renders.

AVDisplayDynamicRangeAutomatic.doc: Defines an automatic dynamic range. Indicates that the dynamic range will be set automatically.

AVDisplayDynamicRangeConstrainedHigh.doc: Defines a constrained high dynamic range. Allows for constrained High Dynamic Range (HDR) video content which is useful for mixing HDR and Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) content.

AVDisplayDynamicRangeHigh.doc: Defines a high dynamic range. Allows video content to use extended dynamic range if it has dynamic range content.

AVDisplayDynamicRangeStandard.doc: Defines a standard dynamic range. Restricts the video content dynamic range to the standard range regardless of the actual range of the video content.

AVPlayerViewControlsStyle.doc: Constants that indicate which user interface controls the view displays.

AVPlayerViewControlsStyleFloating.doc: The view displays playback controls in a floating window over the video content.

AVPlayerViewControlsStyleInline.doc: The view displays playback controls in a bar along the view’s bottom edge.

AVPlayerViewControlsStyleMinimal.doc: The view presents basic controls to play and pause playback.

AVPlayerViewControlsStyleNone.doc: The view displays no playback controls.

AVPlayerViewTrimResult.doc: Constants that specify an action a user takes when trimming media in a player view.

AVPlayerViewTrimCancelButton.doc: The user clicked the Cancel button.

AVPlayerViewTrimOKButton.doc: The user clicked the Trim button.

AVRoutePickerViewButtonState.doc: Constants that describe the available button states.

AVRoutePickerViewButtonStyle.doc: Constants that define the button styles a route picker view supports.

AVVideoFrameAnalysisType.doc: Constants that define the types of analysis a player view controller may perform on a paused video frame.

AVVideoFrameAnalysisTypeDefault.doc: The default types of analysis to perform.

AVVideoFrameAnalysisTypeMachineReadableC.doc: A type that recognizes machine-readable codes, such as QR codes.

AVVideoFrameAnalysisTypeNone.doc: A type that performs no analysis.

AVVideoFrameAnalysisTypeSubject.doc: A type that finds a subject that a user can copy out of frame.

AVVideoFrameAnalysisTypeText.doc: A type that finds text in a paused video frame.

AVVideoFrameAnalysisTypeVisualSearch.doc: A type that identifies objects, landmarks, art, and so on.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a type from a string value.

+isPictureInPictureSupported.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the current device supports Picture in Picture.

+pictureInPictureButtonStartImageCompati.doc: Returns a system-default template image that’s compatible with a trait collection for the button that starts Picture in Picture in your app.

+pictureInPictureButtonStopImageCompatib.doc: Returns a system-default template image that’s compatible with a trait collection for the button that stops Picture in Picture in your app.

-initWithContentSource:.doc: Creates a Picture in Picture controller with a content source.

-initWithPlayerLayer:.doc: Creates a Picture in Picture controller with a player layer.

-invalidatePlaybackState.doc: Invalidates the controller’s current playback state and fetches the updated state from the sample buffer playback delegate object.

-startPictureInPicture.doc: Starts Picture in Picture, if possible.

-stopPictureInPicture.doc: Stops Picture in Picture, if active.

-initWithRate:localizedName:.doc: Creates a playback speed with a rate and localized name.

-beginTrimmingWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Puts the player view into trimming mode.

-flashChapterNumber:chapterTitle:.doc: Displays the chapter number and title in the player view for a brief moment.

-setMagnification:centeredAtPoint:.doc: Scales the video’s view by a specified factor, and centers the result on a specified point.

-routePickerButtonColorForState:.doc: Returns the color of the picker button for the specified state.

-setRoutePickerButtonColor:forState:.doc: Sets the route picker button color for the specified state.

controlsStyle.doc: The style of the capture controls presented by the view.

fileOutput.doc: The capture file output used to record media data.

videoGravity.doc: A string value that defines how the capture view displays video within its bounds.

AVPictureInPictureControllerContentSourc.doc: An object that represents the source of the content to present in Picture in Picture.

canStartPictureInPictureAutomaticallyFro.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether Picture in Picture starts automatically when the controller embeds its content inline and the app transitions to the background.

canStopPictureInPicture.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether Picture in Picture is active and is able to stop.

contentSource.doc: The source of the controller’s content.

delegate.doc: A delegate object for a Picture in Picture controller.

pictureInPictureActive.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the Picture in Picture window is onscreen.

pictureInPictureButtonStartImage.doc: A system-default template image for the button that starts Picture in Picture in your app.

pictureInPictureButtonStopImage.doc: A system-default template image for the button that stops Picture in Picture in your app.

pictureInPicturePossible.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether Picture in Picture playback is currently possible.

pictureInPictureSuspended.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the system suspends the controller’s Picture in Picture window.

playerLayer.doc: The layer that displays the video content.

requiresLinearPlayback.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the controller allows the user to skip media content.

localizedName.doc: A localized name for a speed that’s suitable for display in a user interface.

localizedNumericName.doc: A localized numeric name for a speed that’s suitable for display in a user interface.

rate.doc: The playback rate to use when you select this speed.

systemDefaultSpeeds.doc: A list of playback speeds the system uses by default.

actionPopUpButtonMenu.doc: An action pop-up button menu that the player view displays.

allowsMagnification.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the magnify gesture changes the video’s view magnification.

allowsPictureInPicturePlayback.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the player view allows Picture in Picture playback.

allowsVideoFrameAnalysis.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to perform video frame analysis.

canBeginTrimming.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the player view can begin trimming.

contentOverlayView.doc: A view that adds additional custom views between the video content and the controls.

magnification.doc: The factor by which the video’s view is currently scaled.

pictureInPictureDelegate.doc: The Picture in Picture delegate object.

player.doc: The player instance that provides the media content for the view.

preferredDisplayDynamicRange.doc: Describes how High Dynamic Range (HDR) video content renders.

readyForDisplay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the current player item’s first video frame is ready for display.

showsFrameSteppingButtons.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the player view displays frame stepping buttons.

showsFullScreenToggleButton.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the player view displays a full-screen toggle button.

showsSharingServiceButton.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the player view displays a sharing service button.

showsTimecodes.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the player view displays timecodes, if available.

speeds.doc: A list of user-selectable playback speeds to show in the playback speed control.

updatesNowPlayingInfoCenter.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the player view controller updates the Now Playing info center.

videoBounds.doc: The current size and position of the video image that displays within the player view’s bounds.

videoGravity.doc: A value that determines how the player view displays video content within its bounds.

AVRoutePickerViewButtonState.doc: Constants that describe the available button states.

activeTintColor.doc: The view’s tint color when AirPlay is active.

customRoutingController.doc: A routing controller that enables connections to non-AirPlay devices.

delegate.doc: The delegate object for the route picker.

player.doc: The player object to perform routing operations for.

prioritizesVideoDevices.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the route picker sorts video output devices to the top of the list.

routePickerButtonBordered.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the route picker button has a border.

routePickerButtonStyle.doc: The button style for the route picker.
